2134-3584-4050-8240.easyPrerequisites: You've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2134-3584-4050-8240.description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Grandmother Goby and Thousand-Year Storm trigger.
Resolve the Grandmother Goby trigger, countering Bond of Inisght and creating four 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Bond of Insight a number of times.
Resolve the first copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and then returning the original Bond of Insight and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat step 5 for other Bond of Insight copies as appropriate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four Merfolk tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

719-997-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-997-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-6887--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-3188--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-3188--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Social Climber ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-3129-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

104-440-1786-7426.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
104-440-1786-7426.description:
Draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Cleric Class trigger.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

3099-4762-6260-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Caradora.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3532-5078-7314-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7510.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
5686-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1545-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2919-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-2919-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

2350-3941-4331-4993.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2292-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

803-5310-6797-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-5310-6797-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1170-1329-1482-1753.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2558-3490-5231-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-5467-6797.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

3764-4871-5231.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1413-2178-2921.notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Thraben Doomsayer.
1413-2178-2921.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Human.
When the Human dies, Thraben Doomsayer triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2187-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Possessed Skaab.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Possessed Skaab.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Possessed Skaab.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1486-3263-3525.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Magda, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability.

229-1881-5220.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

703-2506-3129.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Primal Vigor that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Primal Vigor tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

934-1678-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
Amorphous Axe attached to Mayhem Devil.
934-1678-4508.description:
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

803-1869-3542.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1869-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

859-1424-2741.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1424-2741.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1789-2232-3136-4050.description:
Cast Changeling Outcast by paying {B}.
Changeling Outcast enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Changeling Outcast from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1429-2034-4419.description:
Sacrifice the Lesser Masticore to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Lesser Masticore returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter.
The counters cancel out.
Repeat.

1992-2744-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2744-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

539-3814.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
539-3814.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping itself and any other land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding one mana of any color that land can produce.
Repeat.
